purpose: Select realistic Indian Ocean reinforcements from the reconciled Branch wallet while preserving Central-Pacific opportunity cost and using submarine/observation liaison as the primary mission.

corrected_shipbuilding_logic.young_surface_advantage: primarily avoided historical Solomon/Rabaul losses plus higher availability; only modest 2-5% construction acceleration
corrected_shipbuilding_logic.kaibokan: modest quantity delta; role separation/availability, not dozens of extra 1943 hulls
corrected_shipbuilding_logic.warning: Global physical count now closes at center 103 from named loss-path audit. Theater-transfer availability remains much smaller than physical count.

initial_release_rule.when: Eastern Fleet reinforcement is highly probable/eastbound but has not yet sortied east from Ceylon
initial_release_rule.upper_transfer_without_explicit_Pacific_: 8-11 total modern DD; above this requires explicit Central-Pacific tradeoff
initial_release_rule.CL_release: Oyodo first; Agano or Noshiro only on second gate; Yahagi NO-GO early Jan
initial_release_rule.CA_release: none initially; Suzuya/Kumano pair only on Bay-entry escalation gate
initial_release_rule.secondary_carriers: no automatic commitment; one/two only if later air-risk gate and Pacific situation permit

preferred_initial_mobile_group.why_this_exact_set: All four DD are survival-dividend hulls whose historical Solomon loss chains are absent. This minimizes the opportunity cost of stripping historically-still-alive Pacific screens. Oyodo is the best fit for the Branch DF/ESM/submarine/air-contact fusion mission.
preferred_initial_mobile_group.route: Truk -> Palau -> Balikpapan/Tarakan fuel gate -> Singapore/Lingga
preferred_initial_mobile_group.movement_clock: GO after high-confidence RN eastbound confirmation; 6-8 days center including fuel/coordination stop. A Jan11-12 GO gives Singapore/Lingga arrival about Jan18-21.
preferred_initial_mobile_group.basing: Singapore/Lingga rear; Penang/Sabang forward staging only; never park whole group at Port Blair
mission: one-pass Type-93 strike on fresh contact
avoid sustained daylight/radar gunnery versus RN battle line

why_these_DD.Niizuki_Teruzuki: mature Akizuki hulls whose historical Solomon losses are absent; radar/AA/picket utility is unusually valuable for the observation network
why_these_DD.Takanami_Makinami_Kiyonami_Onami: mature 1942-early-1943 Yugumo hulls, historical loss chains absent, enough training time by Jan1 and no current Branch commitment found
why_these_DD.Suzunami_Hayanami: mid-1943 Yugumo completions with adequate work-up; usable alternates
why_these_DD.late_1943_Yugumo: Asashimo/Kishinami/Okinami are not first-choice Indian transfers because their late-1943 completion leaves less work-up despite modest Branch schedule improvement

second_gate_if_Eastern_Fleet_sorties_eas.add_CL: Noshiro center; retain Agano with Pacific carrier/10th-Squadron-oriented screen unless Pacific state separately frees it
second_gate_if_Eastern_Fleet_sorties_eas.add_DD: 2-3 from Onami / Suzunami / Hayanami, subject to maintenance check
second_gate_if_Eastern_Fleet_sorties_eas.submarines: activate I-27 and I-37 first; target ~7 active/outbound conventional boats. Sentaka 1-2 only if contact age and geometry specifically reward sprint/recontact.

third_gate_if_RN_enters_Bay_Andaman_appr.role: fast heavy cover/night strike and deterrence; do not line-battle QE/Valiant/Renown under Illustrious air cover
third_gate_if_RN_enters_Bay_Andaman_appr.add_surface_note: At this gate one more 2-3 DD escort package may be required; explicitly debit Central-Pacific screen before GO.

special_support.Chitose_or_Chiyoda: retain as a later mobile seaplane-maintenance/recon option; exact Jan origin not yet hard enough to name one as initial mover.
special_support.Nisshin: survives and is a strong fast heavy-logistics candidate, but prior Bengal settlement never actually booked its transfer; do not retroactively place it at Singapore without a dated movement decision.
special_support.old_local_cruisers: Ashigara/Aoba + Kuma/Kinu/Oi/Kitakami remain local cover/transport/presence; young group is not used for routine shuttle work.

submarine_local_nucleus.jan7_clock: I-162 + I-166 remain out; RO-110, I-165 and RO-111 can be out/heading to station = 5 Japanese boats without Pacific transfer.
submarine_local_nucleus.jan10_15_escalation: activate I-27 and I-37 if RN eastbound evidence continues = ~7 active/outbound.
submarine_local_nucleus.late_jan: RO-112 and one additional Southwest boat can lift practical on-station/outbound target toward 7-9.
submarine_local_nucleus.sentaka: 0 initial; 1-2 only after high-value fresh/stale contact geometry makes sprint-recontact useful.
submarine_local_nucleus.German_Monsun: sector-level handoff only, no unified tactical control; western/southwestern Ceylon-Arabian Sea information can cue Japanese eastern sectors.

next_required_action: Run the Jan13-20 parallel clock: actual Truk-group transit/fuel events versus Allied detection/inference while Group A proceeds Suez -> Aden -> Ceylon. Do not instantiate late-Jan British arrivals early.

construction_crosscheck.surface_new_hulls: Modest 2-5% yard acceleration does not create a large extra Jan1 surface class. The decisive delta is survival of 1942-43-built Yugumo/Akizuki hulls.
construction_crosscheck.Yugumo: 16 historically completed by Jan1; Branch keeps all 16 physical center because historical Solomon losses are absent. Later units are not pulled across Jan1 by only 3-5% acceleration.
construction_crosscheck.Akizuki: 6 completed by Jan1; Branch keeps all 6 physical center. Later Akizuki hulls remain 1944 gates.
construction_crosscheck.Agano_class: Agano and Noshiro are mature enough; Yahagi completed 1943-12-29 and remains work-up/no-go for Jan expedition.
construction_crosscheck.Shimakaze: single experimental hull; keep Pacific, no Indian transfer center.
construction_crosscheck.Sentaka: six first-generation hulls are the major genuinely new submarine construction addition by Jan1.

dated_trigger_center.working_threshold_effect: Sufficient for HIGH-confidence eastbound assessment only if delivered to Japanese channels in useful time
